features.name: Halo of Spores
features.desc: As a Reaction, when a creature is within 10 feet of you, you deal Necrotic damage to it (the die increases with level; no saving throw — it's automatic).

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.desc: By expending a use of Wild Shape (instead of transforming), you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 4 × your Druid level; your melee attacks deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and Halo of Spores damage is doubled.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.desc: As a Reaction, when a Beast or Humanoid dies within 10 feet of you, you raise it as a zombie (Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest).

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.desc: As a Bonus Action (while Symbiotic Entity is active), you create a 10-foot cloud of spores for 1 minute: enemies inside take Halo of Spores damage.

features.name: Fungal Body
features.desc: You can't suffer Critical Hits and are immune to the Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, and Poisoned conditions.
